title: HR Advisors for BISO Oslo
content:
Join BISO Oslo’s HR Team!



Do you want to work with HR in practice while contributing to a better student community? As an HR Advisor, you will have a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with real HR tasks such as recruitment, teambuilding, debrief conversations, conflict management, and advising leaders of the student association’s units. Many former HR Advisors say they have learned more from being part of the BISO HR team than from their studies alone. The experience you gain will be valuable whether you aim for a career in HR or aspire to a leadership role, as you will develop skills in expectation management, motivation, and strategic recruitment.



We are now looking for dedicated students who want to make a difference in the student community and contribute to wellbeing and structured HR processes.



How we work:You will be part of an HR team of around 11 students at Campus Oslo. The HR team is organized with four team leaders who are responsible for following up on the lines, committees, projects, and staff functions. Each team consists of 3–4 students working closely together to support the BISO units in their work. With relevant experience from BISO or the HR Advisor role, you may apply internally to become an HR Team Leader – a role that also includes serving as an advisor to the campus leadership. Together, the HR teams work to be a visible and integrated part of the student association, collaborate closely with leaders across campus and units, and contribute to making BISO an inclusive and welcoming place for all members.



What you will gain:




Practical HR experience in a large and active student organization



Skills in recruitment, leadership support, and organizational development



The opportunity to influence wellbeing and culture in the student association



A network and experience that will stand out on your CV




As HR Advisor is an elected position of trust, candidates will be nominated or recommended for the role. The election, including presentations and a Q&A session, will take place at the Academic assosiation.



The term for the position is for one year.



Please send your motivation letter and any other relevant documents to hr.rima.oslo@biso.no.



Questions about the position can also be sent to hr.rima.oslo@biso.no.



Application deadline: August 22th, 2026, at 23:59.

title: HR Advisors for BISO Oslo
content:
Bli med i BISO Oslos HR-team!



Vil du jobbe med HR i praksis og samtidig bidra til et bedre studentmiljø? Som HR-rådgiver får du en unik mulighet til å teste deg på virkelige HR-oppgaver som rekruttering, teambuilding, debrief-samtaler, konflikthåndtering og rådgivning til ledere for enhetene i studentforeningen. Mange tidligere HR-rådgivere forteller at de har lært mer av å være en del av BISO HR-teamet enn de har gjort gjennom studiene alene. Erfaringen du får, er verdifull enten du ønsker en karriere innen HR eller drømmer om en lederrolle, siden du får erfaring med blant annet forventningsavklaring, motivasjon og strategisk rekruttering.



Vi ser nå etter engasjerte studenter som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell i studentmiljøet og bidra til trivsel og ryddige HR-prosesser. 



Hvordan vi jobber:Du blir en del av et HR-team på rundt 11 studenter ved Campus Oslo. HR-teamet er organisert med fire teamledere som har ansvar for oppfølging av linjer, utvalg, prosjekter og stabsfunksjoner. Hvert team består av 3–4 studenter som samarbeider tett for å støtte BISO-enhetene i sitt arbeid. Med relevant erfaring fra BISO eller HR Advisor-vervet kan du søke internt om å bli HR-teamleder, en rolle som også innebærer å være rådgiver for campusledelsen. Sammen jobber HR-teamene for å være en synlig og integrert del av studentforeningen, samarbeider tett med ledere på tvers av campus og enheter, og bidrar til at BISO er et inkluderende og trivelig sted for alle medlemmer.



Dette får du:




Praktisk HR-erfaring i en stor og aktiv studentorganisasjon



Kompetanse innen rekruttering, lederstøtte og organisasjonsutvikling



Mulighet til å påvirke trivsel og kultur i studentforeningen



Nettverk og erfaring som skiller seg ut på CV-en




Vervsperioden er i ett år. Siden HR advisor er et tillitsverv, vil aktuelle kandidater bli innstillt eller nominert til rollen. valget, inkludert appell og spørsmålsrunde, gjennomføres på linjeledermøte. 







Motivasjonsbrev og evt. andre dokumenter du mener er relevante sendes til hr.rima.oslo@biso.no



Spørsmål om stillingen sendes til hr.rima.oslo@biso.no.



Søknadsfrist: 22.august 2026 kl 23.59.

title: Financial Manager – Finans
content:
As the Financial Manager for the student association, you will have overall responsibility for the finances. This includes overseeing the association’s income and expenses, as well as maintaining good communication with the Financial Controller in the BISO Leadership. While experience with Excel, budgeting, and strong numerical skills is beneficial for applicants, it is not a requirement.



Responsibilities:




Create a budget for each semester



Keep track of and manage all financial transactions within the association



Calculate event costs and make financial decisions for the association



Assist the Business Relations Manager in generating income




Personal Qualities:




Independent



Structured and organized



Familiarity with Excel



Interest in finance




A student association is perfect for those who want a social and engaging environment at BI! A student association brings together all three year groups from a specific program, creating a common meeting point. The possibilities are endless! Through a student association, you can organize various events, such as class parties, small and large social gatherings, as well as company presentations relevant to your studies! A student association operates as a low-threshold offer for students, by students, providing a lot of freedom to pursue what you want.



Application with motivational letter, and a CV if you want, can be sent to hr.nora.oslo@biso.no



Application deadline is Sunday 23nd of August 2026

title: Business Relations Advisor
content:
BUSINESS RELATIONS ADVISOR



About BISO Oslo:BISO Oslo is a proactive and dynamic student organization known for its commitment to advancing students' interests and career development. Our goal is to create valuable experiences and opportunities for our members through a wide range of academic and social activities.



About the BISO Business Department:This department handles all collaboration with external companies, sponsors, partners, recruitment agencies, and partner schools. The Oslo Business Department is led by the Head of Business Relations; the rest of the team consists of a Business Relations Advisor, a Business Operations Advisor, and the Head of the Business Committee (NU) at BI. Together, they ensure that BISO Oslo’s strategic and financial goals are achieved.



What to expect:Building and managing relationships between the student organization and the business community for the benefit of members.Creating value for the organization's members through advantageous agreements.Assisting the organization and its sub-units in negotiations with potential partners.



What we are looking for:



We are looking for someone who is proactive, action-oriented, and resourceful. The ideal candidate excels at interacting with others and is eager to build a professional network within the business community. You have a high capacity for work, a solution-oriented mindset, and a strong desire to make a difference for students at BI Norwegian Business School. Additionally, it is relevant if you:Communicate effectively in writing and verbally in Norwegian/EnglishHave a good understanding of Microsoft software (Excel, Word, etc.)



Application process:Please send us a cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this position. You are welcome to include a CV as well, though it is not required. All applications will be treated confidentially.



Application deadline: August 23, 2026, at 23:59Please send your application to: hr.rima.oslo@biso.no



Questions regarding the position may be directed to the Head of Business Relations in Oslo, Fredrik Lund, at business.oslo@biso.no



We look forward to hearing from you!

About BISO Oslo:
BISO Oslo is a proactive and dynamic student organization known for its commitment to advancing students’ interests and career development. Our goal is to create valuable experiences and opportunities for our members through a wide range of academic and social activities.

About the BISO Business Department:
This department handles all collaboration with external companies, sponsors, partners, recruitment agencies, and partner schools. The Oslo Business Department is led by the Head of Business Relations; the rest of the team consists of a Business Relations Advisor, a Business Operations Advisor, and the Head of the Business Committee (NU) at BI. Together, they ensure that BISO Oslo’s strategic and financial goals are achieved.

What to expect:
Building and managing relationships between the student organization and the business community for the benefit of members.
Creating value for the organization’s members through advantageous agreements.
Assisting the organization and its sub-units in negotiations with potential partners.

What we are looking for:

We are looking for someone who is proactive, action-oriented, and resourceful. The ideal candidate excels at interacting with others and is eager to build a professional network within the business community. You have a high capacity for work, a solution-oriented mindset, and a strong desire to make a difference for students at BI Norwegian Business School. Additionally, it is relevant if you:
Communicate effectively in writing and verbally in Norwegian/English
Have a good understanding of Microsoft software (Excel, Word, etc.)

Application process:
Please send us a cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this position. You are welcome to include a CV as well, though it is not required. All applications will be treated confidentially.

Application deadline: August 23, 2026, at 23:59
Please send your application to: hr.rima.oslo@biso.no

Questions regarding the position may be directed to the Head of Business Relations in Oslo, Fredrik Lund, at business.oslo@biso.no

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Business Relation Advisor
content:
BUSINESS RELATIONS ADVISOR  



Om BISO Oslo: BISO Oslo er en fremoverlent og dynamisk studentorganisasjon kjent for sitt engasjement for å fremme studentenes interesser og karriereutvikling. Vårt mål er å skape verdifulle opplevelser og muligheter for våre medlemmer gjennom et bredt spekter av faglige og sosiale aktiviteter. 



Om BISO Business Department: 



Alt samarbeid med eksterne bedrifter, sponsorer, samarbeidspartnere, rekrutteringspartnere og samarbeidsskoler. Oslo Business Department blir ledet av Head of Business Relations, og resten av teamet består av Business Relations Advisor, Business Operations Advisor og leder for Næringslivsutvalget ved. BI(NU). Sammen skal de sørge for at de strategiske og økonomiske målene til BISO Oslo blir oppnådd.  



Hva kan du forvente? 




Bygge og forvalte relasjoner mellom studentorganisasjonen og næringslivet til fordel for dets medlemmer 





Jobbe med å skape verdi for organisasjonens medlemmer i form av fordelaktige avtaler 





Ansvar for å bistå organisasjonen og dens underenheter i forhandlinger med aktuelle samarbeidspartnere 




Hva vi ser etter:  



Vi ser etter deg som er fremoverlent, handlekraftig og ressurseffektiv. Den rette kandidaten er god til å samhandle med andre, og er nysgjerrig på muligheten til å bygge et nettverk innad i næringslivet. Du har høy arbeidskapasitet, en løsningsorientert innstiling og et sterkt ønske om å utgjøre en forskjell for studentene ved Handelshøyskolen BI. I tillegg er det relevant om du: 




Håndterer skriftlig og muntlig kommunikasjon på norsk/engelsk godt 





God forståelse av Microsoft programvare (excel, word, etc.) 




Søknadsprosess: Send oss et motivasjonsbrev der du forklarer hvorfor du er den rette for denne stillingen. Send gjerne CV også, men det er ikke et krav. Alle søknader behandles konfidensielt. 



Søknadsfrist: 23. August 2026 kl. 23:59 Vennligst send din søknad til: hr.rima.oslo@biso.no 



Spørsmål om stillingen kan sendes til Head of Business Relations i Oslo, Fredrik Lund på business.oslo@biso.no  



Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!
